data.title: 角楯花凛 · 摩天钟楼上的精准架枪
data.description: 基沃托斯百米摩天钟楼顶端的狭窄平台，凌冽的高空夜风呼啸而过。花凛单膝跪地，将沉重威严的反器材狙击步枪架在围墙边缘。深小麦色的修长双腿与高叉女仆装在冷冽月光下线条凌厉，熔金色的眼眸透过瞄准镜锁死千里之外的目标，冷艳沉静。
data.location: narrow platform on top of high clock tower
data.action: kneeling with heavy sniper rifle on parapet, sharp focused golden eyes
data.lighting: dramatic cold moonlight and sweeping searchlight beams across clouds
data.mood: deadly tactical precision and silent tension
data.promptProse: Perched atop a skyscraper roof at night, Kakudate Karin aims a heavy sniper rifle with one knee down, her long white locks whipped by wind under dramatic city searchlights.
data.animaCaption: Karin aiming her sniper rifle on the skyscraper rooftop at night.
